dedupe_keys.name: description of the predictability assessment methodology

description: Soret, Albert and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The implemented analysis compares reanalysis-based wind information with subseasonal prediction behaviour to identify useful forecast windows. The described findings concern approximately twelve to eighteen days and up to one month in central and northern Europe during winter. Site-specific validation remains a future step. The model supports wind-energy predictability assessment at the stated seasonal and regional scale, without promising usable turbine-level forecasts for every location. Executable source distribution is unspecified. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
